title: Encoded Artifact
description:
A fictional memory artifact was exported during an authorized forensics lab:

```
SEN7Zm9yZW5zaWNzX2FydGlmYWN0XzQyfQ==
```

The instructor identifies the encoding as Base64 and asks you to recover the embedded artifact.
objective: Decode the Base64 string and submit the resulting value as the flag.

hints.text: The decoded text already uses the HC{...} flag format.
